words.meaning: A powerful and luminous stellar explosion
words.sentence1: The astronomers observed a distant supernova shining brightly in the galaxy. (The astronomers observed a distant supernova shining brightly in the galaxy.)
words.sentence2: A supernova can outshine an entire galaxy for a brief period. (A supernova can outshine an entire galaxy for a brief period.)

words.meaning: A system of millions or billions of stars, together with gas and dust, held together by gravitational attraction
words.sentence1: Nuestra galaxia se llama la Vía Láctea. (Our galaxy is called the Milky Way.)
words.sentence2: Existen miles de millones de galaxias en el universo observable. (There are billions of galaxies in the observable universe.)

words.meaning: The universe seen as a well-ordered whole
words.sentence1: Le mystère du cosmos fascine l'humanité depuis la nuit des temps. (The mystery of the cosmos has fascinated humanity since the dawn of time.)
words.sentence2: Nous explorons les confins du cosmos avec de grands télescopes. (We explore the edges of the cosmos with large telescopes.)

words.meaning: The force of attraction between all masses in the universe
words.sentence1: Die Gravitation hält die Planeten auf ihren Bahnen um die Sonne. (Gravity keeps the planets in their orbits around the sun.)
words.sentence2: Ohne Gravitation würde das Leben im Weltraum nicht funktionieren. (Without gravitation, life in space would not function.)

words.sentence1: Chikyuu wa taiyou o mawaru wakusei desu. (Earth is a planet that revolves around the sun.)
words.sentence2: Ano akai wakusei wa Kasei to yobaremasu. (That red planet is called Mars.)

words.meaning: A cloud of gas and dust in outer space
words.sentence1: La nebulosa di Orione è visibile anche con piccoli telescopi. (The Orion Nebula is visible even with small telescopes.)
words.sentence2: Nuove stelle nascono all'interno di questa magnifica nebulosa. (New stars are born inside this magnificent nebula.)

words.sentence1: Rénlèi duì tàikōng de tànsuǒ cóng wèi tíngzhǐ. (Humanity's exploration of outer space has never stopped.)
words.sentence2: Yuhangyuan zai taikongzhong feiching chuanyue. (The astronaut flew across outer space.)

words.sentence1: Ujuenun sumaneun byeoldulgwa eunhasuga isseoyo. (There are countless stars and galaxies in the universe.)
words.sentence2: Inganun eonjena ujuui bimireul algo sipeohabnida. (Humans always want to know the secrets of the universe.)

words.sentence1: Neak-vi-chhea-sastr siks-sa pi a-ka-kas. (Scientists study about space.)
words.sentence2: Meas pka-chanh chhnanh thla-thlok knong a-ka-kas. (The golden flower floats in the atmosphere.)

words.sentence1: Die heelal is uiters groot en geheimsinnig. (The universe is extremely large and mysterious.)
words.sentence2: Wetenskaplikes probeer om die oorsprong van die heelal te verstaan. (Scientists try to understand the origin of the universe.)
